description: This file contains a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw status codes into human-readable labels for display purposes. It handles null/undefined inputs, replaces underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapses multiple spaces, and applies Title Case formatting while preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a display-friendly label with spaces and Title Case formatting.
